definition.ko: 포수 시점의 좌우 움직임입니다. 양수는 오른쪽입니다.
definition.en: Horizontal break (HB) derived from the Naver nine-parameter trajectory fit.

dictionary.analysisInterval: y=40 ft to y=17/12 ft; VAA evaluated at y=17/12 ft
dictionary.coordinateSystem: Naver PTS / PITCHf/x feet; x catcher right, y toward pitcher, z up
dictionary.sign: HB +x catcher right; IVB positive up; VAA negative downward
dictionary.differenceFromSource: Derived from Naver PTS fits using Nathan mean-velocity drag correction. Not a direct Naver or Statcast reported movement field. Fixed 40 ft reference, not release-to-plate.
dictionary.conditions: Finite, validated PTS fit spanning y=40 ft to the plate front; no imputation.
